name: usage-telemetry
description: Records what the models are doing behind a Claude Code session: which model served each request and what it cost, every tool, skill, MCP and subagent call, Jev's skill decisions and the model router's OpenRouter calls. Keeps them in ~/.claude/usage-telemetry/ and, with USAGE_INGEST_URL set, ships them to a Supabase table so cloud sessions survive the container. A dashboard script turns them into one page.
